data.title: 椎叶紬 · 牵着手回家
data.description: 晚饭后的街道很安静。紬伸手牵住你，走了一段才小声说，她以前想过很多次这样的夜晚。
data.action: holding her partner’s hand while walking home
data.promptProse: On a quiet town street at night, Tsumugi holds her partner's hand while walking home; only their hand enters the frame.
data.animaCaption: Her partner remains outside the frame, with only one hand visible.
